headline: EPACK Prefab Technologies appoints Vikram Kumar Khaitan as Chief Financial Officer

summary: EPACK Prefab Technologies Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about the appointment of Vikram Kumar Khaitan as the company's new Chief Financial Officer.
